# Differences between Minecraft 1.21.8 (the reference) and older 1.21.2 - 1.21.7 that were reviewed and are safe.
# One key per line as LinkCheck prints it after "DIFF".

# The HUD element registry came with Fabric API for 1.21.6. LootHudHook only touches the class that uses it
# when the registry is there, and draws through the older HUD callback otherwise.
type net/fabricmc/fabric/api/client/rendering/v1/hud/HudElement
type net/fabricmc/fabric/api/client/rendering/v1/hud/HudElementRegistry
method net/fabricmc/fabric/api/client/rendering/v1/hud/HudElementRegistry.addLast(Lnet/minecraft/class_2960;Lnet/fabricmc/fabric/api/client/rendering/v1/hud/HudElement;)V

# 1.21.4 put a parent class above the item's render state. FadeState extends the render state itself and uses
# nothing of that parent, so it works with or without it.
ancestor of com/kasper/despawnindicator/client/BlinkingItemRenderer$FadeState: net/minecraft/class_10428
